title: 新加坡总理谈英伟达芯片流向与Megaspeed调查
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We have made very clear a position.
America has export controls on its chips. We do not enforce America's export controls,
segments.zh: 美国对其芯片有出口管制。我们不执行美国的出口管制，

segments.en: but we do not want Singapore to be used and abused as a conduit by companies to circumvent America's export controls.
segments.zh: 但我们不希望新加坡被企业利用和滥用，作为规避美国出口管制的渠道。

segments.en: So what we do is to facilitate checks by America to enforce its own laws.
segments.zh: 因此，我们所做的是协助美国进行检查，以执行其本国法律。

segments.en: At the same time, we are also very clear. We do not want companies to breach Singapore laws.
segments.zh: 同时，我们也非常明确：我们不希望企业违反新加坡法律。

segments.en: So if there are companies that are caught breaching our laws, we will certainly take very firm enforcement actions.
segments.zh: 因此，如果有公司被发现违反我们的法律，我们一定会采取非常坚定的执法行动。

segments.en: So it's on that basis that we were investigating mega speed, which is Singapore-based entity.
segments.zh: 基于此，我们正在调查总部位于新加坡的实体Megaspeed。

segments.en: And we also were investigating Alice Wang herself.
segments.zh: 我们也正在调查Alice Wang本人。

segments.en: But in the cause of our investigations, we did what we did.
segments.zh: 但在调查过程中，我们采取了相应行动。

segments.en: We were tired. With Alice Wang, we took her in.
segments.zh: 我们已疲惫。对于Alice Wang，我们将其拘留。

segments.en: We investigated her. But we eventually released her because there was no basis for further prosecution.
segments.zh: 我们调查了她，但最终释放了她，因为没有进一步起诉的依据。

segments.en: America understands what we have done.
segments.zh: 美国明白我们做了什么。

segments.en: We did ask for some information. Not all of it was forthcoming.
segments.zh: 我们确实要求了一些信息，但并非全部提供。

segments.en: But we did what we did with her. And the investigations with mega speed are ongoing.
segments.zh: 但我们对她采取了行动，而对Megaspeed的调查仍在进行中。
